_comment: Game rule numbers (original values from Capone.EXE). Edit and restart; a missing key keeps the original. Regenerate with -- --export-params.

_fields.HqMaxHp: hit points of a headquarters building
_fields.CompanyHealPerHour: hit points an unowned or legal company heals per game hour
_fields.SurrenderHpRatio: a company gives in to extortion below this share of its hit points
_fields.FortificationRange: sight and shooting range of the fortification business
_fields.ExposedHitmanDamageMin: Hit man damage right after a shot (not hidden), lowest
_fields.ExposedHitmanDamageMax: Hit man damage right after a shot, highest
_fields.MarketShareSteps: [market share %, income multiplier]: the last step at or below the share applies
_fields.LegalizationFactors: income multiplier of a business type by its legalization level 0..3
_fields.ExtortChance: [weekly income, chance %]: extortion base chance, straight lines in between
